rinconraptor:study:1.title: Expanding the dinosaur diversity of the Cerro Overo–La Invernada area (Bajo de la Carpa Formation, Santonian), Northern Patagonia: Description of a new species and additional megaraptorid remains (Palaeontologia Electronica, 2026)

facts.statement: Rinconraptor is classified as a megaraptorid theropod dinosaur.
The genus Rinconraptor was described by Méndez and colleagues.
Rinconraptor was described as a new genus and new species.
The type locality for Rinconraptor is the Bajo de la Carpa Formation.
facts.quote: Type locality: Bajo de la Carpa Formation

facts.statement: Rinconraptor fossils were found in Argentina.
The scientific name of the genus is Rinconraptor.
The only known species in the genus is Rinconraptor pipoae.
The genus Rinconraptor was established by Méndez et al. in 2026.
Rinconraptor lived during the Santonian age of the Late Cretaceous.
facts.quote: known from the Late Cretaceous (Santonian age) Bajo de la Carpa Formation of Argentina.

facts.statement: The Bajo de la Carpa Formation where Rinconraptor was found consists of sandstone and muddy sediments representing fluvial and aeolian systems.
facts.quote: characterized by dominantly sandstone and muddy sediments, representing Santonian-aged fluvial and aeolian systems.

facts.statement: The paleoenvironment of Rinconraptor was semi-arid and supported a diverse ecosystem including turtles, crocodyliforms, ornithopods, abelisaurids, and other megaraptorans.
facts.quote: This formation indicates a semi-arid paleoenvironment that supported a rich terrestrial ecosystem including turtles, peirosaurid crocodyliforms, ornithopods, abelisaurids, and megaraptorans.

facts.statement: Rinconraptor lived between 85.7 and 83.6 million years ago during the Santonian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Santonian to Santonian (85.7 to 83.6 million years ago)

facts.statement: The parent group of Rinconraptor is the family Megaraptoridae.
Rinconraptor belongs to the family Megaraptoridae.
Rinconraptor is classified within the class Reptilia.
The description of Rinconraptor was authored by a team including Ariel H. Méndez and Ariana Paulina-Carabajal.
facts.quote: Authors: Ariel H. Méndez, Ariana Paulina-Carabajal, Leonardo S. Filippi, Federico A. Gianechini, Javier González-Dionis, Lucía F. Vettorazzi, E. Emanuel Seculi-Pereyra, Karen Ulloa-Guaiquin, Francisco T. Barrios, Penélope Cruzado-Caballero, Flavio Bellardini, M. Elena Previtera

facts.statement: The description of Rinconraptor was published in the journal Palaeontologia Electronica.
